summary: Frontend-only test of the Portfolio 'Place separately' / 'Place as one' modes plus 'Set booster (%)' in the Bet Slip, LION Ticket draft cards and the Create a ticket modal. Every requested flow passed in the UI with the QA account. Combined odds are the product of the leg odds. The booster pays a % of NET profit (stake 10 @ x5.00 with 20% gives 58.00, not 60). In combo mode one Lost leg makes the whole ticket -10.00 and all legs Won give 58.00 / +48.00. The no-stake guard and per-leg stake isolation work, and 'Place separately' and older tickets with no mode field still work as before. No functional bugs found, only small UX notes.

design_issues.screen: Portfolio > Bet Slip (Place as one mode)
issues: The per-leg 'Stake €' inputs (slip-stake-*) are still shown and editable in combo mode, but combo ignores them (only the ticket stake counts). The draft TicketCard hides them in combo mode; the slip should do the same, or grey them out, so the two screens match.

action_items: Optional: hide/disable slip-stake-<legId> inputs in the Bet Slip when mode === 'combo' (as the draft TicketCard already does).
Optional: comboOddsOf() / BetSlip comboOdds treat an empty or 0 odds as 1.00 without telling the user. Consider blocking 'Place as one' when a counted leg has odds <= 1.
critical_code_review_comments: PortfolioContext.comboOddsOf uses Number(l.odds) || 1, so a cleared odds input quietly lowers the combined odds instead of being flagged.

computeTicket (separate mode) applies the booster to the aggregate net of all settled legs, not to each single. With a mix of won and lost singles the boost is smaller than a per-single booster would give. This is acceptable if intended; please confirm with the product rules.
BetSlip.place: placeTicket(combo ? amt : amt, ...) has a redundant ternary. Separate mode still requires a default stake even when every leg has its own stake (pre-existing behaviour).
PortfolioPage.jsx is 867 lines; consider moving BetSlip and TicketCard into their own component files.
The booster input accepts negative values (min='0' is not enforced on typing). boostedReturn ignores pct <= 0, so the result is harmless.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 test tickets on the QA account during testing: a slip combo ticket, a manual combo ticket (TEST_A/TEST_C), and 2 LION drafts that were placed. All 4 were removed afterwards by id with the ticket-remove buttons. The 7 tickets that were already on the account were left untouched (2 of them are unplaced LION drafts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: Bet Slip modes, combined odds (1.65*1.48 = 2.44, 24.42 return), booster 58.00, placed combo badge 'One ticket · x5.00' + 'Booster +20%', settlement (all won 58/+48, one lost 0/-10, moves to History). Draft card: mode buttons, combo stake, live combined odds (2.38*1.22*1.24*1.17 = 4.21, editing a leg to 1.5 gives x7.50 / 88.00), per-leg stake inputs hidden in combo mode, typing a stake into one leg does not copy it to others, no-stake combo place shows the toast 'Set the stake you played on this ticket' and stays a draft. Create modal: x5.00 / 10.00 / 58.00, and the card matches. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow. Add slip legs from Matches with add-to-slip-* -> pick-option-* -> slip-confirm-add. LION drafts come from /lion-tickets lt-add-*. Portfolio syncs to the server, so clean up test tickets by id. No odds-provider refresh endpoints were triggered.
